change: The importer continues to verify every pin declared as an importer input in contract-v1.md: the exact official CSV, suggested Turtle, and source-manifest bytes. It no longer additionally opens unrelated research snapshots listed inside that manifest (homepage HTML, procedure notes, vocabulary and license) which do not influence the conversion.
reason: A portable source package should need only its declared processing inputs and attribution record; full third-party webpage snapshots should remain in the local source-review evidence. The independent source review still verifies those snapshots separately.
validation_required: A fresh canonical run must produce the same three output hashes as run-01. The auditor must inspect this change and confirm all processing inputs remain pinned; no acceptance criterion is removed.
